# Tommy Chung - Full-Stack AI Developer & Data Scientist

> Personal portfolio and technical blog focused on full-stack development, generative AI, and modern web technologies.

## Site Information

- Site Name: Tommy Chung
- URL: https://tommy-chung.com
- Type: Personal Portfolio & Technical Blog
- Owner: Tommy Chung
- Location: Toronto, Canada
- Current Role: Senior Data Science Engineer at Robots and Pencils

## Description

Portfolio website and blog for Tommy Chung, a full-stack AI developer and data scientist based in Toronto. The site showcases professional experience, projects, technical skills, and blog posts about web development, AI, and software engineering.
